Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Couple Pairing now shows "your half" of whatever your partner just picked directly in the pairing section — the matching saved preset, or the matching Penumbra animation's own play button(s) — so you don't have to scroll through the Preset Library or Animations tab to find it yourself.
